zh: 新增首页：一眼看完今天还有多少张卡要复习、今日目标差几次、连续学习多久、近七天复习了几次，以及每个词库还剩多少要复习；从首页可以直接开始复习、开始测验或添加词语。状态栏和手势条改为透明沉浸式，内容一直画到屏幕边缘，图标明暗随页面底色自动切换，挖孔屏不再出现黑边。整体动效重做：页面和卡片淡入上浮、词语行与统计格子依次错开出现、按钮按下有回弹、侧栏按钮的悬浮底色淡入、收起/展开的箭头改成旋转而不是换图标。深色主题下侧栏与页面之间补上那道细亮边。修掉一个真 bug：轻提示里的「撤销」按钮此前点不动，点了只让提示消失、词语并没有恢复。
en: New home screen: see at a glance how many cards are waiting today, how close you are to the daily goal, your streak, the last seven days of reviews, and how much is left in each list — with one tap to start reviewing, start a quiz, or add words. The status bar and gesture bar are now transparent and edge-to-edge, content draws all the way to the screen edge, the icon brightness follows the page behind it, and notched screens no longer show a black band. Motion overhauled throughout: pages and cards fade up on arrival, word rows and stat tiles stagger in, buttons give a slight press feedback, sidebar buttons fade their hover tint in, and the collapse chevron now rotates instead of being swapped for a different icon. Dark theme gains the fine lit edge between the sidebar and the page. Fixed a real bug: the undo button inside a toast could not be tapped — tapping only dismissed the message while the deleted word stayed deleted.
